description: AUSTIN, TX — HB 2217, authored by State Representative Trey Wharton (HD 12), passed both chambersof the Texas Legislature with strong bipartisan support and is now awaiting the signature of GovernorGreg Abbott. The bill establishes a statewide grant program to help local law enforcement agenciesoutfit their vehicles with bullet-resistant windshields, windows, and door panels. The…
